I've been expecting you.[XENO:n ]
I was quite certain you would respond[XENO:n ]
to my invitation... And here you are.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Do not feel too pleased with yourself.[XENO:n ]
I said I would spare you, but the offer[XENO:n ]
was only good for one transgression.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

That's right-mo! Pushy men[XENO:n ]
don't win anyone over-mo![XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

This time we'll beat[XENO:n ]
him to a pulp-mo![XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I may regret asking this, but... [XENO:n ]
What is your goal here?[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I doubt you would have gone to all this[XENO:n ]
trouble to stage a teary reconciliation.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]
...You are not fit to rule this new age.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:type type=anger ]I beg your pardon?![XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Though holy commingled blood runs in[XENO:n ]
your veins, complicity with the purebloods[XENO:n ]
marks you as naught...but a filthy traitor.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:type type=anger ]But not me! I will overthrow the pure 
blood, and the accursed past alongside it!
I am the one suited to rule the High Entia![XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

After all this time, you're still clinging[XENO:n ]
to your delusions?![XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:type type=anger ]Gwahahaha![XENO:n ]
I will say it as many times
as it will take![XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:type type=anger ]*I* will rule in this brave new world![XENO:n ]
*My* commingled blood will be paramount![XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:type type=anger ]And *you*...will be dirt beneath my soles![XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

...Gelgar...[XENO:n ]
More than anything, I find you pitiable.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Melia...! Don't underestimate him![XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I know.[XENO:n ]
Very well... Let us end it.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]
